Good to Know

Shipping & Returns

We're not live on Amazon just yet — launching in 2 weeks — but here's exactly how ordering, shipping and returns will work once we are.

How ordering works

Each Craven & Quill title will be a print-on-demand paperback sold on Amazon. Once live, placing an order means Amazon prints your copy and ships it directly to you — we never see or handle payment or order details ourselves.

Shipping times & tracking

Delivery estimates are shown at Amazon checkout and vary by your location and the shipping speed you choose. You can track any order from Your Orders on Amazon.

International availability

Availability depends on the Amazon marketplace in your country. Our books currently list on Amazon.com for the US, with other marketplaces considered as the collection grows.

Returns & refunds

Start a return from Your Orders on Amazon within their standard return window. Amazon processes the refund once your return is received or approved.

Damaged or misprinted copies

If your copy arrives damaged, misprinted or with pages out of order, contact Amazon customer service directly from your order. As the printer and seller of record, they handle replacements and refunds for print-on-demand titles.

Contact us

We're a small, new press and don't have a support line yet. For anything Amazon's order support can't resolve, join our list below and we'll be in touch as soon as we've set up a direct contact address.
